pm_active.meaning: PM is active when executeHedge() is called

blp_reserve_exists.meaning: BLP has an active reserve for the spot asset token being hedged

supplied_balance_reverts_observed.meaning: querying 0x811 for a token never actually supplied to BLP produces a failure response causing suppliedBalance() to revert

assumptions: executeHedge() buys the spot asset on L1 and registers the token in vaultSupplied via notifyVaultSupply before any accounting read occurs.
The accounting read path (suppliedBalance) queries the 0x811 precompile for the registered token.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who calls executeHedge or whether it is permissionless; caller scope of the scenario is unspecified.
Report does not specify the exact spot asset token or amount involved in the hedge.

limitations: Formalizes only the supplied_balance_reverts impact; downstream bricking of totalBackingSigned/surplus/distributableSurplus/settleDailyPnL and operator recovery are separate impacts not covered here.
The relation is expressed as absence of the reported revert outcome; the 0x811 failure-response semantics are bound at code level later.
